script: Your next ninety days begin again at week one, but at a higher level, because you now have samples, a profile and a client history. Here is a last reminder. Measure your progress by what you make and what you send, not by how long you watch. Your first job is a turning point, not a finish line. Each skill you learn, each sample you finish and each message you send adds up. Start today, with one small action. Thank you for watching this series.
